recipes.name: Binging with Babish 4 Million Subscriber Special: Death Sandwich from Regular Show
ingredients: 28 ounce can Whole San Marzano Tomatoes
instructions: Start by making the sauce. In a sauce pan add the minced onion along with some olive oil and saute for 2-3 minutes before adding garlic cloves, tomato paste, dried oregano, and dried red pepper flakes. Mix to combine for 30 seconds. - ½ medium Yellow Onion minced - 2 ½ tbsp Olive Oil - 3 cloves Fresh Garlic separated - 3 tbsp Tomato Paste - ½ tsp Dried Oregano - ¼ tsp Dried Red Pepper Flakes

Add a can of whole San Marzano tomatoes to the pan along with water. Using a potato masher, slowly mash the tomato sauce until it’s smooth. Mix to combine. Add fresh basil. Keep at a simmer over low heat for 45-90 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. - 28 ounce can Whole San Marzano Tomatoes - 7 ounces of Water - 1 sprig Fresh Basil - Salt - Pepper
For your meatballs, saute onion along with cloves of freshly minced garlic. Once fragrant, take off heat and set aside. - ½ medium Yellow Onion minced - 2 cloves Fresh Garlic separated

To a large bowl add fresh parsley and basil along with ricotta cheese, panko bread crumbs, lemon zest, egg, parmesan cheese and ground pork (or ground meat of choice), and your cooled onions and garlic. - Fresh Parsley - Fresh Basil - ½ cup Ricotta Cheese - ½ cup Panko Bread Crumbs - 1 Zest of a Lemon - 1 large Egg - 2 ounces Parmesan Cheese - 1 pound Ground Pork
Mix everything together with your hands and then form into balls.

Over a medium high heat, heat some vegetable oil and then add your meatballs and brown for about 2 minutes on each side. Once they are browned, finish the cooking by adding them to a wire rack on a rimmed baking sheet and bake at 375°F for about 20 minutes. - Vegetable Oil

Slice your submarine roll in half lengthwise and then add a layer of sauce and top that with a row of deli ham. Next, add your meatballs and then the other half of the sandwich bread. - Submarine Sandwich Roll - Deli Ham
